CustomField.description: OpenAI chat-completions model identifier sent on every broker-email extraction callout. Replaces LLMExtractionCalloutService.MODEL ('gpt-4o-mini'). Changing the model changes behaviour on broker_email / property_address, the Property_Registry__c claim key — re-run both manual regression fixtures named in LLMExtractionCalloutService's header before and after any change, and diff the normalised addresses by hand. The callout ENDPOINT itself stays hardcoded in Apex (the ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3 direct-OpenAI retirement lever) and is not affected by this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: OpenAI model id, e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Changing it affects the broker/property claim key — re-run the regression fixtures.
CustomField.label: Model
